## Where This Lives in UpstreamDrift {#sec-upstream-implementation-pog-ch23}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The downloadable [`teaching_arm.urdf`](../../The_Physics_of_Golf/models/teaching_arm.urdf) and `TwoLinkArm.urdf()` generator in this repository are AffineDrift teaching assets. UpstreamDrift hosts the production humanoid and golfer URDF trees that engine wrappers import at commit [`27b6eead`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/commit/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da).

- **Simple humanoid teaching model:** [`simple_humanoid.urdf`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/shared/urdf/simple_humanoid.urdf)
- **Generated golfer (Drake export):** [`golfer.urdf`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/engines/physics_engines/drake/models/generated/golfer.urdf)
- **Bundled humanoid library entry:** [`humanoid.urdf`](https://github.com/D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift/blob/27b6eeadbbd970bebb8926a3c83aeaea1f6ee4da/src/shared/python/model_generation/library/bundled/simple_humanoid/humanoid.urdf)

**Convention note:** compare `nq`, `nv`, and body ordering in each asset's MJCF/URDF header before matching the numeric accelerations printed in this chapter; MuJoCo 3.3.x versus 3.4.x releases differ only in patch semantics, not in the joint-index contract for a pinned file.
:::
